summary: Each ingredient is open but they live in separate resources: genus membership and a synthesized tree (Open Tree of Life), raw multi-locus sequences (GenBank), and extinct genera with ages (PBDB, 72,445 extinct vs 17,981 extant animal genera as returned by the extant filter). No resource distributes per-locus gene trees for congeneric sets or links living congeners to a dated extinct ancestor.
next_step: Choose several well-sampled genera with multi-locus data (e.g. via GenBank gene queries), build or take per-locus trees, and compare against OTL topology and PBDB first appearances of the genus; freeze a pre-molecular genus list to avoid circularity.
obstacles_confirmed: No ready table of per-locus gene trees for congeners.
Fossil ancestors cannot be identified from PBDB alone.
TimeTree was only checked at landing-page level.
